question: Can the cited Pinto 1985 fish dissertation be recovered online, and what can an authoritative catalog record establish?

catalogueRecord.host: Philippine eLib; hosted by the University of the Philippines Diliman Main Library
catalogueRecord.title: Community structure and population dynamics of mangrove fishes of Pagbilao, Quezon, Philippines
catalogueRecord.author: M. Leonard (Mihindukulasuriya Leonard) Pinto
catalogueRecord.documentType: Ph.D. dissertation, University of the Philippines Diliman
catalogueRecord.physicalLocation: University of the Philippines Diliman Main Library, University Archives; reference room use only

additionalBibliographicCheck.finding: A DOST-NAST bibliography independently cites Pinto's 1985 PhD dissertation by the same title and UP Diliman affiliation.
additionalBibliographicCheck.limits: This corroborates the citation only; it does not provide thesis contents, methods, taxon tables, gut data, or a digital copy.

dietTableLineage.decision: The catalog confirms an author named Pinto and a same-year Pagbilao fish dissertation, making it a strong retrieval lead. It does not prove that the 1997 table's “Pinta” is a typographical error or that the selected food items were derived from this thesis; original pages and table context remain unavailable.

interpretation: The thesis is a real, cataloged UP Diliman archival item, but it is not downloadable from the reviewed eLib record and is marked for reference-room use only.

The catalog's subject headings place the dissertation at Pagbilao mangroves generally; it does not identify the experimental forest, named creek/river, stations, sampling dates, fish specimens, or diet methods.
No thesis data or tables were reviewed. The record improves access provenance only and does not validate any species, occurrence, food item, bait recommendation, or current population claim.
nextActions: If the dissertation's gut-content or species tables are needed, use the listed call number and reference-room access details to ask the UP Diliman Archives about lawful consultation and note-taking conditions; no request has been sent.
Continue the CALABARZON inland-water source sweep with independently retrievable lake and river studies while keeping historical catalog leads separate from species assertions.
Do not use the table's broad diet categories for Bangwit until the original thesis and reuse conditions can be reviewed.

sources.supports: Official UP Diliman archival catalog metadata, call number, physical location, and unavailable digital copy.
